segments.text: Mr.James Scott has a garage in Silbury
segments.translation: 詹姆斯·斯科特先生在锡尔伯里有一个汽车修理站，

segments.text: and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.
segments.translation: 现在他刚在平赫斯特买了另一个修理站。

segments.text: Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury,
segments.translation: 平赫斯特离锡尔伯里只有5英里，

segments.text: but Mr. Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage,
segments.translation: 但斯科特先生无法为他的新修理站安装电话，

segments.text: so he has just bought twelve pigeons.
segments.translation: 所以他刚刚买了12只鸽子。

segments.text: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
segments.translation: 昨天，一只鸽子把第一封信从平赫斯特带到了锡尔伯里。

segments.text: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.
segments.translation: 这只鸟只用了3分钟就飞完了全程。

segments.text: Mr.Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts
segments.translation: 斯科特先生已经发送了大量索取备件的信件

segments.text: and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
segments.translation: 和其他紧急信件从一个修理站发到另一个修理站。

segments.text: In this way, he has begun his own private 'telephone' service.
segments.translation: 就这样，他开始了自己的私人'电话'业务。
